title: Predictive Fragment Sampler and Spill Hedging for KV Cache
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Improves KV cache retention and reduces spill frequency by ~28% in mixed workloads. No API changes. Backfill recommended for large dedicated fleets.
description: Motivation: In high-multiplexing tenant workloads we observed intermittent spill storms driven by fragmentation and bursty allocations that were not captured by the existing occupancy thresholds. This PR implements a predictive fragment sampler plus a spill-hedging admission controller to reduce unnecessary spilling and smooth eviction traffic. Design summary: 1) Predictive Fragment Sampler: lightweight probabilistic sampler that maintains per-segment fragmentation estimates and a short-term decay window. Sampler outputs a fragmentation score used by the eviction controller to prefer compaction of high-fragmentation segments instead of blind LRU-style wholesale eviction. 2) Spill Hedging Admission Controller: when memory pressure is detected, the controller applies soft preemption hints and staggered spill windows by tenant. Hedging delays low-value spills briefly (configurable ms) to allow ongoing batch completions or KV-cache compaction to reclaim space, reducing cold disk I/O. 3) Reservation Windows and Soft Preemption: allocate small transient reservation windows for hot tenants to avoid immediate evictions on transient bursts; eviction policies accept a "soft_preempt" flag to avoid fragmenting compaction work across critical inference paths. 4) Continuous batching interaction: sampler exposes a pressure hint to the batching layer so the runtime can opportunistically reduce max batch size during high fragmentation periods to bound KV cache pressure. Implementation notes: Added src/kv/cache/fragment_sampler.{cc,h}, src/kv/cache/spill_hedger.{cc,h}, extended eviction_controller.{cc} to use fragmentation scores, and a new metric set perf/metrics/kv_fragmentation.{prom}. The sampler is implemented lock-free using epoch counters to minimize impact on hot paths. Tests and benchmarking: microbench tests in tests/kv/fragmentation_simulator_test.cc exercise synthetic fragmentation patterns. Perf lab harness perf/benchmarks/kv_spill_hedging.yml runs mixed chat+search trace for 30m. Results: steady-state mixed workload shows 28% reduction in disk spill events, 12% improvement in 99th-percentile generation latency, and 3.5% CPU reduction on the serving node under test. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout starting in canary region, 48h observation window, automatic rollback on spill increase >10% or tail-latency regression >5%. Follow-ups: integrate sampler into dedicated capacity autoscaler signals, add tenant-level tuning UI in console, and explore offline ML model to predict fragmentation hotspots. Related: follows up on ENG-1620 and complements work in the kv-compactifier series.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Nice approach. Can you clarify overhead of the sampler in the hot allocation path? Provide contention numbers.

Sofia Patel: The sampler uses epoch counters and only updates probabilistically (1/128 by default). Microbench shows <1% overhead on allocation-heavy traces. Added numbers to description and unit test harness.
Aisha Gomez: Need to ensure hedging windows cannot be abused by tenants to hoard memory. Suggest adding tenant throttles and a max-window bound.
Sofia Patel: Added tenant-level max_window_ms with default 250ms and a cluster-level cap. Also added unit test for tenant throttling.
Ravi Kapoor: CI flagged a flaky test due to timing in fragmentation_simulator_test. Please make the test tolerant to jitter.
Sofia Patel: Adjusted test to use event-driven ticks instead of real-time sleeps; rerun CI.
Aisha Gomez: Approved after changes. Ravi: Approve.
summary: Add predictive fragmentation sampling and spill hedging to reduce spill events and tail latency under mixed workloads while minimizing hot-path overhead. Feature-flagged rollout with tenant safety caps.
notes_for_release: Feature-flag default: disabled for hosted customers. Enable in Dedicated or Private with operator review. Observability dashboards added under KV Cache -> Fragmentation.
